events.name: TicketDiscovered
events.summary: The conductor found a new ticket to work on, from a GitHub issue, a person, or an agent's follow-up.

events.name: TicketClaimed
events.summary: The conductor claimed a ticket and began a run on it.

events.name: TicketContinued
events.summary: A person approved a held run, and it went on.

events.name: TicketReleased
events.summary: The conductor gave up its claim on a ticket, so the ticket can be taken again.

events.name: WaitStarted
events.summary: A ticket stopped to wait for a person's decision.

events.name: WaitResolved
events.summary: A person answered a waiting ticket.

events.name: TicketSplit
events.summary: A person approved splitting a ticket into smaller ones, and which of them depend on which.

events.name: SplitStarted
events.summary: The conductor began creating the child tickets of an approved split on GitHub.

events.name: SplitChildWritten
events.summary: The conductor created one child ticket of a split on GitHub and confirmed it exists.

events.name: SplitLinkWritten
events.summary: The conductor set one blocked-by link between two child tickets on GitHub and confirmed it.

events.name: SplitFailed
events.summary: Creating the tickets of a split stopped partway, because a step failed or GitHub refused.

events.name: TicketLinked
events.summary: No longer written: a link saying one ticket caused, followed up, or duplicated another.

events.name: TicketLanded
events.summary: A ticket's change was merged into the base branch.

events.name: TicketSatisfied
events.summary: A ticket ended satisfied by what the base already held.

events.name: TicketClosed
events.summary: A person closed the ticket without landing it.

events.name: DispatchRefused
events.summary: The conductor refused to start an agent because its runtime cannot fail closed.

events.name: RunStarted
events.summary: An agent's run started on its own worktree, cut from the base commit.

events.name: RunPrompted
events.summary: The conductor handed the agent its prompt.

events.name: RunTouchedFile
events.summary: An agent edited, wrote, or deleted a file during its run.

events.name: RunContextExhausted
events.summary: An agent ran out of room in its context and had to compact, a sign the ticket was too large.

events.name: RunAwaitingInput
events.summary: An agent stopped to ask for input instead of carrying on.

events.name: RunProducedDiff
events.summary: An agent's run left a branch with changes on it.

events.name: RunRefsPublished
events.summary: The conductor tried to push a run's branches to the remote, and recorded whether it pushed, had nothing to push, or was refused.

events.name: RunKeptUncommitted
events.summary: The conductor saved a stopped agent's uncommitted work as a commit of its own, so it was not lost.

events.name: RunAppliedKeptWork
events.summary: No longer written: the conductor carried a stopped run's uncommitted edits into the new worktree before the agent started.

events.name: RunProposedCompletion
events.summary: An agent finished and offered its work, so the checks began.

events.name: RunFinished
events.summary: An agent's process ended.

events.name: SandboxBoundaryRecorded
events.summary: The sandbox boundary one action's invocation ran under.

events.name: SandboxConnectionsRefused
events.summary: The outbound connections the sandbox refused one invocation.

events.name: RunFailed
events.summary: An agent's run failed.

events.name: RunSpent
events.summary: One paid call to an agent runtime finished, and what it cost was recorded.

events.name: StepsResolved
events.summary: The conductor worked out the plan for a run: what will happen at each of its ten steps.

events.name: RecipeRecorded
events.summary: No longer written: the conductor recorded a recipe, once, under the hash that names it; a run's `StepsResolved` carries it again.

events.name: EndActionsResolved
events.summary: The conductor worked out what to do at the end of a run, given how the run ended.

events.name: StepStarted
events.summary: A step of a run began.

events.name: StepEnded
events.summary: A step of a run ended, with the result of every action it ran.

events.name: FindingAccepted
events.summary: A person accepted a minor review finding, to be worked as a ticket of its own.

events.name: FindingProposed
events.summary: The ticket that an accepted finding asked for now exists in the ticket store.

events.name: FindingDeclined
events.summary: A person declined a minor review finding.

events.name: MergeLaneWaited
events.summary: A run was ready to merge but waited, because another run was landing.

events.name: IntegrationAttempted
events.summary: The conductor tried to merge a run's branch into the base branch.

events.name: IntegrationRefused
events.summary: The merge of a run's branch into the base branch was refused.

events.name: IntegrationSucceeded
events.summary: A run's branch was merged into the base branch.

events.name: BaseChecked
events.summary: The conductor ran a project's check command on the base branch and recorded whether it passed.

events.name: BaseFixProposed
events.summary: The conductor opened the one ticket that makes a red base green and recorded which one it is.

events.name: PassRouted
events.summary: No longer written: the step after review chose where the ticket goes next; `ProposalRouted` replaced it.

events.name: ProposalRouted
events.summary: The step after review chose where the ticket goes next; the log keeps the offer, and names the StepEnded that holds the evidence.

events.name: StepRerunInPlace
events.summary: No longer written: a step run again in place, under the name it had before; the rows already on the log read as the new one.

events.name: StepRedone
events.summary: A run a transient API error cut off is run again in place, after a wait that grows.

events.name: ConductorPaused
events.summary: The conductor paused itself over a tier a runtime cannot provide, and takes no new work until a person resumes it.

events.name: ConductorResumed
events.summary: A person resumed the conductor after the setup's pause.

events.name: DayCeilingReached
events.summary: Today's spend reached the daily ceiling; no new work starts until it is lifted.

events.name: DayCeilingLifted
events.summary: The daily ceiling was lifted: a new day, the configuration, or a person raising today's figure.

events.name: ConductorShutdownRequested
events.summary: A person asked the conductor to stop once the pass in flight finishes.

events.name: ConductorStarted
events.summary: A conductor started, and recorded who started it, why, and from which commit.

events.name: ConductorShutdownWithdrawn
events.summary: No longer written: a request to shut the conductor down was withdrawn.

events.name: OutboxDelivered
events.summary: No longer written: a queued action, such as posting a GitHub comment, was carried out.

events.name: OutboxFailed
events.summary: No longer written: a queued action, such as posting a GitHub comment, failed.

events.name: IssueUpdated
events.summary: Lingtai changed a GitHub issue, such as a comment, its labels, or closing it, and GitHub accepted the change.

events.name: IssueUpdateFailed
events.summary: Lingtai tried to change a GitHub issue and the change was refused or failed.

events.name: QueueChanged
events.summary: GitHub reported a change to a project's issues, so the queue needs another look.

events.name: RunRequested
events.summary: A person asked for a ticket to be run now.

events.name: ContinueRequested
events.summary: A person approved a held run, so the conductor owes it a continuation.

events.name: DiscussionRequested
events.summary: A person asked a question about a ticket.

events.name: DiscussionAsked
events.summary: A question went to the discussion assistant, along with a note of what it could read to answer.

events.name: DiscussionAnswered
events.summary: The discussion assistant answered a question, saying what it read and what it could not establish.

events.name: DiscussionHeld
events.summary: A discussion was filed away, having produced a prompt edit, a ticket, or nothing.

events.name: PromptEdited
events.summary: A person added a sentence to the next run's prompt, or took the sentence away.

events.name: ProjectOnboardingStarted
events.summary: No longer written: a person began adding a repository, which was recorded but not yet worked.

events.name: ProjectConfigured
events.summary: A project was registered with its owner, its base branch and the hash of the configuration resolved for it.

events.name: ProjectRecipeChanged
events.summary: A project's declared recipe changed, recorded as the text a person wrote and its hash.

events.name: ProjectSandboxObserved
events.summary: A run met a sandbox state different from the last one recorded for its project.

events.name: ProjectRefused
events.summary: The conductor could not look at a project and said why, once, when it began.

events.name: ProjectRecovered
events.summary: The conductor looked at a project it had refused and no longer refused it.

events.name: ProjectPaused
events.summary: A person paused one project: it starts no new work until resumed.

events.name: ProjectResumed
events.summary: A person resumed one project.

events.name: PrSubmitRequested
events.summary: A person asked to submit the personal branch as a PR: the first event of a PR's stream.

events.name: PrSubmitRefused
events.summary: A submit request was refused while it was served; that PR number is spent.

events.name: PrInProgress
events.summary: A PR's branch was frozen at one commit with the tickets it holds, and it is In progress.

events.name: PrStepDone
events.summary: One of a PR's In progress steps finished, on the head commit it ran on.

events.name: PrWaiting
events.summary: A PR's step needs a person before it can go on: the PR is Waiting on you.

events.name: PrPushed
events.summary: A PR's branch is on the remote at one commit, pushed now or found already there.

events.name: PrDraftOpened
events.summary: A PR is open on GitHub as a draft pull request, opened now or found already there.

events.name: PrOpened
events.summary: A PR is In review: on GitHub with a pull request, or on another remote, unfollowed.

events.name: BranchSynced
events.summary: Main is in a PR's commit: it already was, or it was merged and built clean; the merge is the PR's target.

events.name: PrMergedBack
events.summary: A PR's branch was merged back into the personal branch, built and pushed.

events.name: PrMergeBackFailed
events.summary: Merging a PR's branch back into the personal branch did not complete; with why unknown, whether the push landed is not known.

events.name: SyncRoundStarted
events.summary: A round of the conflict agent started on a PR: one commit merged into another, round n.

events.name: SyncRoundRefused
events.summary: A round of the conflict agent was refused, and what refused it.

events.name: PrMerged
events.summary: A PR was merged, found by git reachability or reported by the code host.

events.name: PrClosed
events.summary: A PR was closed on the code host without merging; its tickets return to Draft.

events.name: PrRoundsGranted
events.summary: A person gave the conflict agent three more rounds for one commit of main.

events.name: PrRetryRequested
events.summary: A person asked for a waiting PR to be checked again, after resolving it by hand or re-running a workflow.

events.name: PrHeadAdopted
events.summary: A head a person pushed to the PR branch was adopted as the PR's last pushed commit.

events.name: PrBackRequested
events.summary: A person asked to take a PR back: close the draft and return its tickets to Draft.

events.name: AccountLimitReached
events.summary: An account (a runtime's, or github) reached its limit; no project that uses it starts new work until it is lifted.

events.name: AccountLimitLifted
events.summary: An account's limit was lifted: its time passed, or a person said it is over.

events.name: Reconciled
events.summary: A restarted conductor found state the log did not predict, and recorded what it did about it.

events.name: GitHubAppCreated
events.summary: A person created the team's GitHub App from Lingtai's setup page.

events.name: TriageStarted
events.summary: The conductor began triaging a waiting ticket, using an agent or its own rules.

events.name: WaitTriaged
events.summary: The conductor finished triaging a waiting ticket, with advice or a failure.

events.name: PluginFailed
events.summary: An event subscriber was given an event and did not finish handling it.
